description: Source code implementing a SimpleWorker class for job processing in Mattermost, including methods for running, stopping, executing jobs, and handling job success/error states.

classes.name: SimpleWorker
classes.description: A worker class for processing jobs asynchronously, with control over start, stop, and job execution, including success and error handling.

methods.name: NewSimpleWorker
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SimpleWorker instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker's main loop to process jobs until a stop signal is received.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing jobs.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Executes a given job, handling claiming, execution, and success/error updates.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed and updates progress.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.
